title: Energy-Conditioned Noise Schedule and Whitening for Spectral Diffusion
title_zh: 基于能量的噪声调度与白化：光谱扩散研究

paragraphs.en: This paper introduces an energy-adaptive noise scheduling and whitening strategy for transform-domain diffusion models. Existing spectral diffusion methods account for the non-uniform statistics of transform coefficients through coefficient scaling, normalization, or frequency prioritization, while the forward diffusion noise schedule remains largely independent of the underlying spectral-energy distribution. We investigate whether the temporal evolution of the forward diffusion process should also follow the spectral organization of natural images. The proposed formulation combines global spectral whitening with energy-conditioned noise allocation that jointly modulates the injected noise according to the energy of individual transform coefficients and an image-dependent energy path over diffusion time. The resulting forward process preserves Gaussian transitions with closed-form marginals and remains compatible with standard DDPM and DDIM procedures without modifying the diffusion architecture. Experiments on CIFAR-10 demonstrate the contribution of the proposed energy-conditioned noise schedule and spectral whitening, reducing Fréchet Inception Distance from 142.48 for a compact DCTdiff U-Net variant to 100.45.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种适用于变换域扩散模型的自适应能量噪声调度与白化策略。 现有的频谱扩散方法通过系数缩放、归一化或频率优先处理来考虑变换系数的非均匀统计特性，而前向扩散的噪声调度在很大程度上仍独立于底层的频谱能量分布。 我们研究了前向扩散过程的时序演化是否也应遵循自然图像的频谱组织方式。 所提出的公式将全局频谱白化与基于能量的噪声分配相结合，根据单个变换系数的能量以及随扩散时间变化的图像相关能量路径，共同调节注入的噪声。 由此得到的前向过程保留了具有闭式边缘分布的高斯过渡特性，并且无需修改扩散架构即可与标准的 DDPM 和 DDIM 流程兼容。 在 CIFAR-10 上的实验表明，所提出的基于能量的噪声调度与频谱白化方法有效降低了 Fréchet Inception Distance：对于一种紧凑型 DCTdiff U-Net 变体，该指标从 142.48 降至 100.45。

paragraphs.en: Denoising diffusion models [ 11 , 6 , 12 ] formulate image generation as the reverse of a stochastic process that progressively transforms data into Gaussian noise. Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM) [ 6 ] and Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models (DDIM) [ 12 ] provide stochastic and deterministic realizations of this principle, respectively, while continuous-time formulations have been investigated in [ 13 ] . Most existing diffusion models operate directly on pixel representations, where the forward diffusion process applies an identical noise schedule to every image coordinate.
paragraphs.zh: 去噪扩散模型 [ 11 , 6 , 12 ] 将图像生成表述为一个随机过程的逆过程，该过程逐步将数据转化为高斯噪声。 去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）[ 6 ] 和去噪扩散隐式模型（DDIM）[ 12 ] 分别为此原理提供了随机和确定性的实现，而连续时间表述已在 [ 13 ] 中得到研究。 大多数现有的扩散模型直接作用于像素表示，其中前向扩散过程对每个图像坐标应用相同的噪声调度。

paragraphs.en: Recently, several studies have investigated diffusion in transform-domain representations, including the Fourier [ 2 , 3 ] and discrete cosine transform (DCT) [ 1 ] domains [ 8 , 4 ] . Unlike pixel representations, transform coefficients possess well-defined spectral meaning and exhibit highly non-uniform statistical properties. In natural images, most of the signal energy is concentrated in a relatively small number of low-frequency DCT coefficients, whereas higher-frequency components contain substantially less energy. Consequently, the transform domain is characterized by a pronounced imbalance between spectral components.
paragraphs.zh: 最近，多项研究探讨了变换域表示中的扩散现象，包括傅里叶域 [2, 3] 和离散余弦变换（DCT）域 [1] [8, 4]。 与像素表示不同，变换系数具有明确定义的光谱含义，并表现出高度非均匀的特性。 在自然图像中，大部分信号能量集中在数量相对较少的低频 DCT 系数中，而高频成分则包含的能量要少得多。 因此，变换域的特点是各光谱分量之间存在显著的不平衡性。

paragraphs.en: Recent transform-domain diffusion models explicitly account for this imbalance. DCTDiff [ 8 ] introduces coefficient scaling, signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) scaling, and frequency prioritization to improve optimization in the DCT domain. Moreover, the authors show that image diffusion exhibits a spectral autoregressive behavior, indicating that transform coefficients contribute unequally throughout the diffusion process. These observations suggest that spectral diffusion fundamentally differs from pixel-domain diffusion and should exploit the underlying spectral organization of natural images.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的变换域扩散模型明确考虑了这种不平衡性。 DCTDiff [ 8 ] 引入了系数缩放、信噪比（SNR）缩放和频率优先策略，以改善 DCT 域中的优化过程。 此外，作者指出图像扩散表现出一种谱自回归特性，表明变换系数在整个扩散过程中贡献不均。 这些观察结果表明，谱扩散与像素域扩散存在根本差异，应当利用自然图像内在的谱组织特性。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by these observations, we investigate a complementary question that, to the best of our knowledge, has not been addressed previously: should the forward diffusion noise schedule itself depend on the spectral-energy distribution? Existing transform-domain diffusion methods adapt the representation, coefficient scaling, or optimization strategy, whereas the temporal evolution of the forward diffusion process remains largely independent of the spectral energy associated with individual transform coefficients.
paragraphs.zh: 受这些观察结果的启发，我们研究了一个补充性问题：据我们所知，这个问题此前尚未被探讨——前向扩散噪声调度本身是否应该依赖于谱能量分布？ 现有的变换域扩散方法会调整表示方式、系数缩放或优化策略，但前向扩散过程的时间演化在很大程度上仍与单个变换系数相关的谱能量无关。

paragraphs.en: This paper introduces an energy-conditioned noise scheduling and whitening strategy for transform-domain diffusion models. Rather than proposing a new diffusion architecture, the objective is to investigate spectral-energy-aware noise scheduling as an independent component of existing transform-domain diffusion frameworks. The proposed schedule depends on diffusion time, coefficient energy, and image-dependent spectral energy, assigning smaller perturbations to dominant spectral components while modulating their temporal evolution according to the spectral-energy distribution of each image. The resulting formulation preserves the standard Gaussian diffusion framework and remains directly compatible with conventional DDPM and DDIM training and sampling procedures.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种基于能量条件的噪声调度与白化策略，适用于变换域扩散模型。 本文的目标并非提出一种新的扩散架构，而是研究一种能够感知频谱能量的噪声调度方法，并将其作为现有变换域扩散框架的一个独立组件。 所提出的调度方案依赖于扩散时间、系数能量以及图像相关的频谱能量，它会将较小的扰动分配给主导的频谱成分，同时根据每幅图像的频谱能量分布调节这些成分的时间演化过程。 由此形成的公式保留了标准的高斯扩散框架，并且能够直接与传统的 DDPM 和 DDIM 训练及采样流程兼容。

The objective is not to compare different diffusion architectures, but to evaluate the influence of energy-conditioned scheduling within the same transform-domain diffusion framework. The proposed formulation is presented in Section 3 , its relation to DCTdiff is discussed in Section 4 , and the experimental evaluation is given in Section 5 .

paragraphs.en: The baseline framework described in the previous section follows the standard DDPM formulation with a uniform forward noise schedule. Recent theoretical analysis of transform-domain diffusion has shown that the diffusion process inherently exhibits spectral autoregressive behavior, whereby high-frequency components progressively lose their signal-to-noise ratio earlier than low-frequency components under isotropic Gaussian perturbations [ 8 ] . This behavior follows directly from the power-law energy profile of natural images and provides a theoretical justification for treating individual spectral components differently during diffusion.
paragraphs.zh: 上一节描述的基准框架遵循标准的 DDPM 公式，并采用均匀的前向噪声调度。 近期对变换域扩散的理论分析表明，扩散过程本质上呈现出谱自回归行为：在各向同性高斯扰动下，高频成分的信号与噪声比会比低频成分更早逐渐降低 [8]。 这种行为直接源于自然图像的幂律能量分布特征，并为在扩散过程中对不同谱分量进行差异化处理提供了理论依据。

paragraphs.en: ECSdiff introduces a spectral diffusion strategy that advances the DCTdiff philosophy [ 8 ] while retaining its baseline framework defined in Section 2 .
paragraphs.zh: ECSdiff 引入了一种光谱扩散策略，该策略在延续第 2 节中定义的基线框架的同时，进一步推进了 DCTdiff 的理念 [ 8 ]。

paragraphs.en: DCTdiff compensates for spectral imbalance through Entropy-Consistent Scaling (ECS), Entropy-Based Frequency Reweighting (EBFR), and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) scaling. ECS applies a common factor η \eta to all retained coefficients, x k ′ = x k / η x_{k}^{\prime}=x_{k}/\eta , whereas EBFR weights the denoising objective according to the entropy of individual frequency distributions. Since ECS moves low-energy coefficients closer to zero, DCTdiff additionally scales the SNR of the default noise schedule to compensate for their earlier corruption.
paragraphs.zh: DCTdiff 通过熵一致性缩放（ECS）、基于熵的频率重新加权（EBFR）以及信噪比（SNR）缩放来补偿频谱失衡问题。 ECS 对所有保留的系数应用一个公共因子 η \eta，即 x k ′ = x k / η x_{k}^{\prime}=x_{k}/\eta ，而 EBFR 则根据各频率分布的熵值对去噪目标进行加权。 由于 ECS 会将低能量系数向零拉近，DCTdiff 还会额外调整默认噪声调度的信噪比，以补偿这些系数在早期受到的干扰。
